scope: Offline reanalysis of the earlier neutral_02 recorded trial; no new device sampling or human gesture accuracy test.

interpretation.observed: Most rejected observations contain no detected face. A further 24 have valid tracking and acceptable frame age but are rejected by the production freshness predicate.
interpretation.inference: The 24 rejected tracked observations are consistent with an epoch mismatch; per-result epoch identifiers were not logged, so this is not independently proven for each frame.
interpretation.confirmed_source_defect: Before the panel freshness fix, HP pose.valid was tracking && age<=400 and omitted the production epoch/fresh eligibility. This could label a rejected observation valid in a phone snapshot.
interpretation.not_fixed_by_panel_patch: The 208 zero-face detector outputs, continuous pose eligibility, gesture accuracy and servo home calibration remain unverified.
